metadata.name: 16x32_pixel_pine_tree_sprite
metadata.description: 16x32 pixel pine tree sprite in Stardew Valley style. Evergreen conifer tree with triangular/conical shape. Dark green needles (#006400) and dark brown trunk (#654321). Top-down orthographic perspective. Characteristic pointed triangular silhouette of pine tree. Footprint is 12x8 pixels at trunk base. Clean pixel art with black outline, geometric triangular layers.
